title: Epigenetic Inheritance via Fuzzy Soft Hyperstructures
content: We integrate hyperstructure theory with fuzzy soft sets to establish a parameterizedalgebraic model for epigenetic inheritance. By defining hyperoperations governed by environmentalinputs, we formalize external triggers such as temperature fluctuations, soilnutrients, and acoustic stress. The structural properties of these systems are investigated,demonstrating that the resulting fuzzy soft Hv -semigroups preserve weak associativity.
